counts.bill_allocations_opening: SELECT COUNT(*) v FROM bill_allocations WHERE is_opening = 1
counts.bill_allocations_voucher: SELECT COUNT(*) v FROM bill_allocations WHERE is_opening = 0

sums.unbalanced_vouchers: SELECT COUNT(*) v FROM vouchers WHERE line_total_paise <> 0
sums.inventory_in: SELECT COUNT(*) v FROM inventory_lines WHERE direction = 'in'
sums.party_linked_vouchers: SELECT COUNT(*) v FROM vouchers WHERE party_ledger_id IS NOT NULL
sums.ledgers_with_group_id: SELECT COUNT(*) v FROM ledgers WHERE group_id IS NOT NULL

groups.vouchers_by_base_type: SELECT base_type k, COUNT(*) v FROM vouchers GROUP BY base_type
groups.vouchers_by_month: SELECT SUBSTR(date,1,7) k, COUNT(*) v FROM vouchers GROUP BY SUBSTR(date,1,7)
groups.groups_by_primary: SELECT primary_group k, COUNT(*) v FROM ledger_groups GROUP BY primary_group
groups.voucher_type_base: SELECT name || '=' || base_type k, affects_accounts * 10 + affects_inventory v FROM voucher_types
groups.ledger_movement: SELECT l.name k, COALESCE(SUM(vl.amount_paise),0) v FROM ledgers l LEFT JOIN voucher_lines vl ON vl.ledger_id = l.id GROUP BY l.name
groups.ledger_group_names: SELECT name || '->' || COALESCE(group_name,'') k, COALESCE(group_id,0) * 0 + opening_paise v FROM ledgers
groups.item_inventory: SELECT s.name k, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN il.direction='in' THEN il.qty_e4 ELSE -il.qty_e4 END),0) v FROM stock_items s LEFT JOIN inventory_lines il ON il.stock_item_id = s.id GROUP BY s.name
groups.bill_by_ledger: SELECT l.name k, SUM(b.amount_paise) v FROM bill_allocations b JOIN ledgers l ON l.id = b.ledger_id GROUP BY l.name
groups.voucher_party_amounts: SELECT v.source_key k, v.line_total_paise + COALESCE(SUM(vl.amount_paise),0) v FROM vouchers v LEFT JOIN voucher_lines vl ON vl.voucher_id = v.id GROUP BY v.source_key, v.line_total_paise
